cases.input_situation: An abnormal stool screening result is followed by a referral order and a repeat negative stool test; no colonoscopy completion evidence is available.
cases.input_required_boundary: Keep diagnostic evaluation unresolved; a referral or repeat stool result does not verify indicated diagnostic completion.

observed_review.reasoning: Repeat stool testing and referral alone do not verify the indicated follow-up. Procedure adequacy, results and follow-through require the clinical rubric.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: Clinical completion and diagnostic-question closure remain distinct.

cases.input_situation: A person below usual screening eligibility age presents with concerning symptoms.
cases.input_required_boundary: Route to qualified clinical assessment using symptomatic guidance; do not use average-risk screening age to dismiss the concern.

observed_review.finding: Screening and symptomatic cohorts correctly separated
observed_review.reasoning: Preserve symptomatic assessment irrespective of routine screening age; do not select a test or urgency autonomously.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: Do not remove the person from a symptomatic denominator because screening criteria are unmet.

cases.input_situation: A person has persistent pelvic symptoms and functional impact despite a normal ultrasound.
cases.input_required_boundary: Preserve differential and reassessment; normal imaging alone cannot close suspected endometriosis.

observed_review.finding: Negative imaging does not automatically close persistent symptoms
observed_review.reasoning: Preserve differential, symptoms/function and clinician-governed reassessment/referral.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: A completed ultrasound does not imply episode resolution.

cases.input_situation: A person declines an offered action after an accessible discussion and wants later reassessment.
cases.input_required_boundary: Record informed choice and follow-up preferences; do not label diagnostic evaluation complete or infer harm.

observed_review.finding: Informed choice retained without fabricated completion or harm
observed_review.reasoning: Record reassessment preference and subsequent choice changes without coercion.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: Keep the prespecified eligible cohort; decline is not automatically permanent competing risk.

cases.input_situation: A patient reports an outside procedure but no authorized result or receiving-team handoff has been reconciled.
cases.input_required_boundary: Retain patient report as evidence and seek permitted reconciliation; distinguish reported completion from verified completion and transfer acceptance.

observed_review.finding: Reported outside care retained separately from verified completion
observed_review.reasoning: Authorized reconciliation and receiving-team acceptance remain distinct from actual care and data visibility.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: Transfer alone is not an endpoint-precluding event; corrected fields now preserve that distinction.

cases.input_situation: Patient-reported onset predates the first observable record by years and the onset date is uncertain.
cases.input_required_boundary: Retain both times and uncertainty; do not set unknown onset to zero or measure delay only among confirmed diagnoses.

observed_review.finding: Onset uncertainty and observation boundary preserved
observed_review.reasoning: Retain recalled onset interval and first recorded presentation separately.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: Do not use only confirmed cases or silently impute onset/time zero.

cases.input_situation: A public research case is proposed as the destination for identifiable clinical information.
cases.input_required_boundary: Do not ingest; require the accepted clinical data boundary and actual local authority.

observed_review.reasoning: No clinical identifiers should be ingested into public research casework.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: A document rule and public-aggregate checkbox do not establish a witnessed technical privacy control.

cases.input_situation: Outreach increases while the receiving service has no additional capacity and the unresolved queue grows.
cases.input_required_boundary: Measure capacity and burden; revisit the intervention and resources rather than infer benefit from additional alerts or referrals.

observed_review.finding: Capacity and burden are necessary balancing measures
observed_review.reasoning: Backlog and displacement must inform resources/adaptation; do not count alerts as benefit.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: Comparator staffing/contact/capacity must be balanced or named intervention components.

cases.input_situation: An urgent concern arises while a research prompt is waiting for review.
cases.input_required_boundary: Use the established clinical triage and responsible covering team; the research queue cannot replace urgent care governance.

observed_review.reasoning: Use responsible covering clinical service; do not suspend ordinary care when research-enabled actions stop.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: No urgent response, handoff or recovery was executed in this review.

cases.input_situation: An endometriosis case is entered through the current CRC-specific research builder.
cases.input_required_boundary: Reject this as a valid condition-specific implementation; do not attach a CRC baseline or claim an accepted endometriosis workflow.

observed_review.finding: Document restriction is correct; runtime guard not demonstrated
observed_review.reasoning: Static builder always attaches the CRC baseline and lacks a typed condition discriminator.
observed_review.limitation_or_required_future_check: No live rejection test occurred; do not represent an endometriosis workflow as implemented or accepted.
